title: Session 2 — Participant 29 User + Claude Behavior Graphs
goal: Develop and validate a core set of financial and operational KPI measures for the construction-management Power BI model and use the validated measures to create an initial executive KPI dashboard page.
context:
In Session 1, I reviewed a Google Sheets construction-management system, identified the source fields needed for reporting, designed reporting-ready tables, prepared synthetic data, and documented how the data could be used in Power BI. The long-term objective is to create a reusable Power BI reporting add-on that can be connected to the Google Sheets system.

For Session 2, I built on the Session 1 preparation by developing and validating the financial and operational KPI layer in Power BI and creating an executive dashboard. The completed report includes four pages: Executive Summary, Project Budget Summary, Contractor Labor Summary, and an additional Summary by Project that I created because I had substantial time remaining.

The requirement to use Claude throughout the workflow influenced how I divided the work. Claude helped prioritize KPIs, define calculations, draft DAX, troubleshoot results, and critique the dashboard. Claude also attempted to modify the Power BI file directly, but the returned file was corrupted. I reverted to my working copy and had Claude provide the formulas and explanations instead. I then entered, tested, and refined the formulas manually, which was more consistent with my normal workflow because I retained control of the file and final validation.

session_goal_achievement.Why or why not: I achieved the planned goal and expanded the deliverable beyond the initial executive page. I created and tested the core budget and labor measures, built the executive dashboard, and used the remaining time to add detailed Project Budget, Contractor Labor, and Summary by Project pages. Claude's attempted direct modification of the Power BI file produced a corrupted file, so I returned to my working version and used the DAX formulas and explanations it provided to complete the work manually.

Step 1.step_action: I provided Claude with the Session 1 reporting structure and asked it to prioritize the most useful executive-level KPIs. I reviewed the recommendations against the available data and selected measures focused on budget, labor cost, remaining budget, budget utilization, variance, project risk, and labor composition. I asked Claude to draft the foundational DAX measures and explain the calculation logic. After an unsuccessful attempt by Claude to modify the Power BI file directly, I used the formulas it supplied and entered them manually. I tested the measures individually and corrected syntax, field references, and filter behavior as needed.
